title: Text: DET Ben Fidelman ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Signing wife beaters. #Fireavila
[Attachment: Image]
I really like the Martin signing, though
Yeah I’m ok with it. There are some Rule Five options in OF that I personally think would have been a better investment.
Love the Norris signing. All reports from MLB were extremely positive on him from their investigation - they gave him the minimum penalty. Can’t beat a former all star on a MiLB contract.
Eh
Disagree on both!

It’s hard to hide a Rule 5 positional player on the big league roster the entire season: They’re probably going to be a bench guy and not get enough reps to show full potential. Martin fits them well with good D in center and lefty bat. Six years of team control.

I wouldn’t have faced the domestic violence questions with a backup catcher. There’s not enough of a reward. From a baseball perspective, I’d sign Derek Norris to that deal. Overall, I wouldn’t. Frankly, I would have re-signed Holaday because he’s a veteran presence and a really good game-caller.

First off, Martin has one year of control left, not six, whereas you can have much more control from a rule five position player that can contribute both this year and beyond. Secondly, Norris has served his time for the DV and we’re very comfortable with the amount of liability taken on there (not much). Talk about low reward... Holaday stunk and wanted $$. This was the right play.
Excuse me, two years of control on Martin. We can offer arb in 19.
Ok
Martin is way better than a Rule 5 player. He’s played like 4-5 full seasons total in the big leagues
I just wouldn’t have opened myself up to those questions with Norris, he’s not good enough. I’m pretty sure he’s a terrible defender, too. I get the “upside,” I’m just not feeling it.
Re: Holaday, he’s a backup catcher. It’s an intangible position on the roster.
Boyd doesn’t come within an out of a no-hitter if not for Bryan Holaday!

Martin is better than a rule five player in 2018. But who cares about 2018. Rule five player is better in 2020-21 when it matters. In my opinion, Holaday would have been a Toledo back up behind Greiner. Not worth the $ he was asking for.
And let’s put it this way, are you writing a Norris DV story?
What kind of money was Holaday asking for?
Don’t know, but it was enough to make Norris worth it.
How can you use that as your sticking point, then. I bet it wasn’t that much more than Norris. Norris just has more upside, baseball-wise
I haven’t written a domestic violence story on Norris yet. I’d prefer not to until it is absolutely necessary but if my sports editor gets wind of it, my hands may be tied
I haven’t acknowledged it for that reason. If I acknowledge it, as a journalist, I should be reporting on the issue and asking questions as such
We view Norris as a non-issue. No spin. MLB gave us a solid thumbs up, which they have no reason or incentive to do unless it’s the truth.
Norris got $1.5 million
No way Holaday was asking for more than that
Norris is a former All Star, Holaday has 162 games in parts of six seasons in the majors. Norris’s worth in baseball and value are vastly more than what Holaday’s are.
Norris was an All-Star because the A’s needed a representative in 2014. Holaday is a better baseball player than him
Guess we’ll have to agree to disagree on this one
Yes
Let Tony Paul write the DV story. Stay out of the weeds on this one
Oh, man. He’s probably already on it, isn’t he
Without a doubt.
I’m not doing anything with it. I probably should, but I like Al.
